summary: New Mountain Finance Corp filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a Seventh Supplement to its Note Purchase Agreement for a private placement of $150M aggregate principal amount of senior notes (Tranche A fixed at 7.28% due 2028, Tranche B fixed at 7.76% due 2031, Tranche C floating due 2031) issued by the registrant as issuer. The offering is exempt under Section 4(a)(2), not registered, with customary covenants. No special situation such as acquisition or restructuring is present; this is routine debt financing.
